title: Alaska Glacier Helicopter Ride with 2 Landings for 90 minutes
includes: Up-close views of stunning blue glacier pools (summer only)
90-minute scenic helicopter flight through the Chugach Mountains
Wildlife spotting opportunities for moose, Dall sheep, mountain goats and both black and brown bears
Second landing on an alpine ridge or glacier lake
Landing on a remote glacier with 15-20 minutes to explore on foot
Comfort surcharge for guests over 250lbs to ensure proper weight distribution and safety (not included)
Transportation from Anchorage to Girdwood available. Please call our office for more information (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
Per FAA guidelines, infants younger than 24 months old can fly on a parent’s lap; children aged 2 years and older must have their own seat purchased for them.
Weight limit is 290 lbs per seat (and a combined max of 600 lbs for 3 passengers).
policies: Subject to favorable weather conditions. If canceled due to poor weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date or full refund.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the stunning beauty of Alaska from the sky on a thrilling helicopter ride that includes two unforgettable landings. This Glacier Discovery Tour takes you above the breathtaking landscapes of Girdwood Valley and the Chugach backcountry, giving you the chance to explore a giant glacier and a scenic mountain ridge. Keep your eyes peeled for wildlife as you soar over majestic mountains and expansive glaciers. Perfect for anyone looking for an easy yet exhilarating experience, this tour promises incredible views and ample photo opportunities.

- 1.5-hour duration with two glacier landings for exploration
- Easy activity level; suitable for all adventurous travelers
- Scenic views of glaciers and wildlife while flying
- Year-round availability with expert pilots guiding the adventure
